sloka: रामः तु आश्रमम् आसाद्य त्रासयन् मृग पक्षिणः ।गत्वा मुहूर्तम् अध्वानम् भरद्वाजम् उपागमत् ॥२-५४-९॥
transliteration: rāmaḥ tu āśramam āsādya trāsayan mṛga pakṣiṇaḥ ।gatvā muhūrtam adhvānam bharadvājam upāgamat ॥2-54-9॥

translations.english: Seeing Rama approaching the hermitage the deer and the birds were frightened. Proceeding on the path, for a while Rama reached (the place of) Bharadwaja.
